$comment: openspec-handoff-workflow config. Installed to <project>/.openspec-handoff/config.json. Edit freely.

ai-hero.howTo: Two-axis review (Standards + Spec) of `git diff {base_ref}...HEAD`. Use the OpenSpec change folder as the Spec source: proposal.md and the spec deltas are the requirements; execution/spec.md and execution/tickets/ are implementation context only.

superpowers.howTo: Fill the code-reviewer.md template with DESCRIPTION = the proposal's Why/What Changes, PLAN_OR_REQUIREMENTS = the spec deltas plus execution/plan.md, BASE_SHA = {base_ref}, HEAD_SHA = HEAD. Report Critical / Important / Minor.

claude.$comment: Claude Code headless print mode; plan permission mode keeps the reviewer read-only.

codex.$comment: OpenAI Codex CLI; "-" reads the prompt from stdin; read-only sandbox.

ollama.$comment: Local open-weight model via a running `ollama serve` (open source, free). Plain model without tools, so the change files and diff are inlined into the prompt.

cursor-agent.$comment: Cursor CLI; prompt passed as the final argument. Catch-all runner.

localReviewers.$comment: Free, open-weight reviewers run on this machine via Ollama (no account, no API key). Use with --reviewer-model or reviewer_model in handoff.md.
